Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key. Source: metabolism, compound_records (substrate), compound_structures (substrate), compound_records (metabolite). Join: metabolism INNER JOIN compound_records AS substrate_records ON metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate_records.record_id; metabolism INNER JOIN compound_structures ON substrate_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno; metabolism LEFT JOIN compound_records AS metabolite_records ON metabolism.metabolite_record_id = metabolite_records.record_id. Filter: None. Sort: canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key. Limit: 200.
